v3lum/core/detect.py + v3lum/core/ioc.py: labelled-VIN rule for free text (P320 c1): a 17-character value without I/O/Q (at least one letter and one digit) right after a VIN / V.I.N. / chassi / chassis / nº do chassi / número do chassi label is a vin entity (pivot expand=False from text); never a bare 17-character token. Today only the vin:/VIN: TYPE prefix is detected; vin_decoder covers analyst-typed keywords with its own detect_labelled_vins().

notes: P320 vin_decoder: one third_party module (council metadata: opt-in, trusted, open, passive) that decodes offline first (bundled WMI table of 748 WMIs: 734 NHTSA vPIC registrants/makes + 14 curated Brazilian brand hints for WMIs vPIC does not list, e.g. 9BD/93H; country from the ISO 3780 range, never vPIC's registrant country; check digit enforced only for WMIs 1-5, a Brazilian mismatch is a note) and then asks vPIC DecodeVinValues (1 request, 1 req/s, 500/day, 30-day cache, US-centric label on every online fact). vPIC errors live in HTTP 200 bodies (ErrorCode): 'no vehicle data' is a vPIC EMPTY source status; 401/403/429/5xx/timeouts/non-JSON/unexpected shapes are 'could not verify' source statuses while the offline facts stand (email_basics pattern). The full VIN never appears in attributes, findings or evidence (mask_vin; core masks exports). Also accepts KEYWORD inputs with a VIN/chassi label (offline decode + vin pivot) to cover c1 until core detection has the label rule. No owner/plate/registration host, pivot or link. Provider fragment nhtsa (owners.json null host) + notice for the bundled table. P368 elf_triage: offline (disclosure none, TLP:RED, default-on) per the G12 rule of pe_triage: bounded stdlib ELF reader in process (equal to pyelftools 0.33 on all fixtures and 661 system binaries) until core/sandbox.py exists; pyelftools child (optional extra elftools.json, pinned <0.34) only in the sandbox. Markers (UPX, packed_unknown, entropy, no section headers, nonstandard interpreter, truncated/out_of_bounds) are INFO findings tagged elf_hint/packer_hint/context_only; GNU build-id -> keyword pivot has_build_id expand=False. telfhash package not used (c4): yaraify/abusech/structural_hash_pivots already pivot telfhash fields; observation for the yaraify owner: it accepts only t1+70 hex while MalwareBazaar documents 70 hex without prefix. Deviation recorded: the batch header says a module needing a new dependency reports UNAVAILABLE 'package' without it; elf_triage does not need pyelftools (own stdlib reader, as pe_triage with pefile), so requires_packages is empty and the extra is optional. No LIGHT/ACTIVE variants were asked. Dev-time tooling (vPIC WMI fetcher/table builder, pyelftools comparison script) stayed in the session scratchpad.
